name: io.github.arimunandar/figsnap-mcp
description: The Figma file you have open, as MCP tools. Extract, edit, and keep a saved set.

environmentVariables.name: FIGSNAP_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Where the figsnap-mcp daemon is listening. Default http://127.0.0.1:3058; only needed if you moved it.

environmentVariables.name: FIGSNAP_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The daemon's token. Not normally set: the server reads ~/.figsnap-mcp/agent-token, which the daemon writes itself.
